# Yassine Bouali — Backend Software Engineer

> Backend Software Engineer focused on Python, FastAPI, Django, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and software architecture.

Yassine Bouali is a backend software engineer based in Casablanca, Morocco, open to remote and relocation opportunities. The portfolio covers backend engineering, software architecture, API design, relational data modelling, containerised deployment with Docker, and retrieval-augmented generation as a complementary capability. The strongest verifiable evidence is yb-observability, an open-source Python library published on PyPI with tests and a typed public API.

## Featured Projects

- [yb-observability](https://www.ybouali.dev/projects/yb-observability): Open-source Python library for configuration and logging, published on PyPI with a tested public API.
- [Document Processing RAG Pipeline](https://www.ybouali.dev/projects/rag-pipeline): Private backend project exploring asynchronous document ingestion and retrieval-augmented generation.
- [ft_transcendence](https://www.ybouali.dev/projects/ft-transcendence): Real-time multiplayer platform built with NestJS, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, and JWT.
- [API Developer Portal Template](https://www.ybouali.dev/projects/api-docs-template): Reusable, API-agnostic developer portal for publishing professional API documentation.
